|strategy=By [mailto:briank@decipher.com Brian Kallenbach]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/hoth/dark/small/captainlennox.html</ref>

Lennox is one of the many power 2, ability 2 characters that the Dark Side has at its disposal, and has a few interesting points that can make him a mainstay in almost any Imperial deck. First, he is both a pilot and a warrior, which can be helpful in many situations. Characters like [[Lieutenant Tanbris]] are only pilots, giving them less usability on the ground. Second, like [[Officer Evax]], Lennox has an amazing forfeit of 5. The two of them together can protect even the weakest of starships, without having to worry about losing one of your Star Destroyers.

Combos:

[[Captain Lennox]] + [[Tractor Beam]] - this combination is relatively obvious, but can have many dramatic effects on the game. Besiege your opponent's [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]], or Corvette, and use it as your own. You can even Besiege a Rebel [[Red Leader{{!}}Leader]] or Squadron starfighter, giving you a nice power boost, as well as an extra 2 ability.

A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the card-type or stat bar, the game-text box and the numbers beside it) with the corrected game text, and below it a black strip with the title and a white E, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 January 2013.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-captainlennox-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Captain Lennox]] (Decipher, 1996; Decipher's [[Captain Lennox (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes to Decipher's errata wording, the same words as [[Captain Lennox (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's November 1998 errata]]: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots (3 if starship is ''Tyrant''). When on a Star Destroyer, may use its tractor beam once during each of your control phases.”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Captain Lennox” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
